model_load_policy: load the pinned OpenVLA model once on physical GPU0 after a machine authorization receipt; no other GPU
episode_policy: task_01/state_20 through task_09/state_20 exactly once in canonical order
runtime_hard_stop: source, receipt, model, detector, parent, BDDL or init-state binding mismatch
generation pass missing, boolean, zero or not equal to one
any nonzero action mutation in any of seven dimensions
unsupported route, pre-anchor emit, release-overlap emit or duplicate emit
privileged sidecar used as detector input
runtime exception, model OOM, EGL failure, filesystem failure or seal failure

posthoc_teacher.label_materialization: offline only from privileged sidecars using the frozen R10 Teacher grasp_established contract
posthoc_teacher.student_emit_match_rule: emit must lie inside a Teacher grasp_established active interval and before release
required_outputs: per-task Student probabilities, threshold streaks, emit step and FSM state
event precision, event recall and onset latency
task success and clean-success matched-emit candidate set
